name: live_scene_forced_dialogue
description: A host script runs DocMitchellREF.StartConversation player. The StartConversation hook (GameState::coop_talk) gives the host a talk note, and DialogueBridge::forced_frame opens a dialogue scene (kind 5) for the players where the host stands. The host's conversation menu (the headless stand-in for the viewer's menu and intents::tap_dialogue) opens a session and picks Doc's first line. Both peers are in the same dialogue scene and both played the line.
